content.title: ORS FXNet a reinforcement learning assisted dual phase LSTM framework for multi currency INR exchange rate forecasting
content.abstract: Predicting the Indian Rupee (INR) has been challenging in the past. It is prone to overtones not just in global currency fluctuations and commodity price shocks, but also in the country’s macroeconomic conditions. Existing forecast models are either independent FX-pair-based, linear-based, or single-scale neural network-based, and thus fail to adequately model the multi-currency, multi-factor, and multi-time-scale dynamics of the INR.
